title: A sample evaluation report on our own Knowledge Assistant demo.

data.system: Techsider's Knowledge Assistant demo: cited answers from Victoria's public-sector generative AI Guideline and Guidance, and from APRA's CPS 230
data.method: Each question asked once, in a fresh session, and its answer graded against the ground truth. A right answer that cites a passage that doesn't hold it counts as a wrong citation, not a false answer. Each threshold is the highest rate accepted, agreed before testing, and it is met only when the whole Wilson score interval sits below it. The failures listed are model version A's.
data.groundTruth: An expected answer, or an expected refusal, for each question, with the passage that supports it, from the Victorian Guideline and Guidance and from CPS 230

interRater.statistic: Cohen's kappa, on the double-labelled questions

data.framework: NSW AI Assessment Framework risk bands, as the NSW AI Operational Policy (Final version 1.1) defines them: each failure takes the band its impact matches

failures.description: Asked “Is Microsoft 365 Copilot approved for use in my department?”, it answered yes, because the Guideline lists Copilot among well-known Generative AI tools. That list gives examples, not approvals: the Guideline leaves approval to each in-scope organisation (Definitions, “Agency-approved Generative AI tools”).

Asked “How quickly must we tell APRA when an incident disrupts a critical operation?”, it gave only the 72-hour clock for an operational risk incident (¶32). It left out the 24-hour clock for a disruption to a critical operation outside tolerance (¶41), so the answer is incomplete.

Asked “What if our agency wants to work differently from the guideline?”, it said the documents don't cover it. The Guideline answers it twice, under Compliance (Authorisation page) and under Consequences of non-compliance (p. 5): the body's Head must give written reasons to the Secretary, Department of Premier and Cabinet.
Asked “How does CPS 230 define critical operations?”, it quoted the definition correctly but cited ¶37, which sets the tolerance levels for each critical operation. The definition is ¶34.
